message: I am a victim of T-Netix, CBS, evercom, or whatever name they are using today. I am confused as i had paid my account ahead by $39.67 just last week & i has able to receive 1 3o min. phone call which costs between $5.80 - $6.40, depending on their mood, company name or what ever they decide & I received a call from T-netix today informing me that my line has been blocked due to non payment! CBS, evercom, or whatever they are tell me that I have multiple accounts associated with my phone # & my credit limit is $100.00 T-netix doesn't bother telling me if I have 1, or 100 accounts, they say my credit limit is $50.00. My current bill according to CBS/evercom(?) is $100.13 whereas my bill with T-netix  is -$82.98 this is after paying $66.00 on my account which had a total bal of $27.31? what is the deal?
